description: This Java source file defines the EntityObjectCache class, which extends an abstract cache class to provide caching for entity objects within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods to get, put, and remove cached objects based on entity name, condition, and a key name.

classes.name: EntityObjectCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing entity objects in the OFBiz framework, supporting operations such as get, put, and remove.

methods.name: EntityObjectCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an object from the cache based on entity name, condition, and key name.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores an object in the cache associated with an entity, condition, and key name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an object from the cache based on entity name, condition, and key name.
